To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the fake images are mainly used to promote fake news, (ii) the fake images have been created by a small group of users, (iii) the fake users are mainly from the United States and (iv) the fake users have a high percentage of tweets with fake images.
We present the "FakeTweet Buster" (FT), a web application which uses a combination of three different techniques to identify fake tweets and users on Twitter.

(i) fake images can be detected using the reverse image searching approach, (ii) fake users can be detected using an user analysis technique, (iii) the crowd sourcing approach can be used to detect malicious users, (iv) fake tweets can be classified using a combination of the previous techniques.

the following questions. (1) How to detect fake images on Twitter? (2) How to identify users consistently promoting fake images? (3) What is the credibility score of a tweet and a user?
